dct_description_sm: "This is spatial data from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population for the Regional Municipality of Durham, originally published by Statistics Canada.This spatial data is of census Dissemination Area (DA) geography, for the Durham census division (CD). The column "DAUID" can be used to identify specific DA's and to link census tables, such as total population and dwellings."
dct_title_s: 2021 Census - Durham Region Dissemination Areas Boundary
